import sys

def main():
    input_line = sys.stdin.readline().rstrip('\n')
    final_count = 0
    
    if input_line:
        nucleotides = list(input_line)
        i = 0
        while i < len(nucleotides):
            current = nucleotides[i]
            j = i
            while j < len(nucleotides) and nucleotides[j] == current:
                j += 1
            length = j - i
            if length % 2 == 0:
                final_count += 1
            i = j
    
    print(final_count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
